description: We’re a team from KazUTB in Astana, Kazakhstan. We love robotics and anything where code meets hardware. In 2026 we won 1st place at the Fibonacci Robot Olympiad (FootBot Lego League), and in 2025 took 1st place in IT Projects at the international Agroinnovations competition. We build prototypes fast and finish what we start. Looking for people strong in data (Python, ML, satellite imagery), a designer and a great presenter. Love space? Join us!
